title: Practice something that does not need to be published
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Name one difficulty — Choose a small skill and an observable question.; Make a private attempt — Use a bounded exercise with non-sensitive material.; Inspect the evidence — Compare the attempt with the question, not a public score.; Keep a small trace — Record the revision and the next uncertainty..
